name: CONFIG_TABLE_NAME
purpose: Table holding the per-source mapping configs and the alert rules

name: STATE_TABLE_NAME
purpose: Table holding the delivery claims, the current-state snapshots and the alert state

name: ALERT_EVENT_BUS_NAME
purpose: Event bus the threshold status-change events are put on

name: ALERT_EVENT_SOURCE
purpose: The Source field on every status-change event this engine puts on the bus; the EventBridge rule that routes them matches on it

name: ERROR_PREFIX
purpose: Prefix in the landing bucket that rejected files and records are written under; must not be covered by the notification filter

name: METRICS_NAMESPACE
purpose: CloudWatch namespace the rejected-record and files-processed metrics are published in

name: CLAIM_TTL_DAYS
purpose: How many days a delivery claim is kept before the state table expires it; a whole number greater than zero
